candidate_workaround: Pass directories to ripgrep and express filename matching with repeated --glob filters instead of shell-style wildcard path operands on Windows.
failure_signature: Ripgrep received wildcard path operands that Windows treated as invalid literal filenames.
recurrence_guard: On Windows, give rg real directories and use --glob for selection; do not assume the shell expands wildcard path operands.
rollback: Give the invalid inspection zero discovery credit and rerun a bounded directory-plus-glob query.
scope_boundary: Owner-local repository inspection only; no evidence claim beyond the returned files and lines.
title: Use ripgrep directory roots with explicit Windows glob filters
